title: Android Compose Layout From Screenshot
description: Converts a pasted reference screenshot into a production-grade Jetpack Compose component with stateless+stateful pair, multi-config Previews (light/dark × portrait/landscape), and a Paparazzi snapshot test. Runs an LLM-vision comparison loop between generated snapshots and the reference for up to 3 iterations, then either ships or produces a markdown report on remaining gaps in the conversation language.
trigger_description: Trigger when an image of a UI is pasted/attached and the user wants Compose code that matches it — phrases like 'zrób layout z tego screena', 'odtwórz ten ekran w Compose', 'build this UI', 'match this mockup', 'recreate this design', 'implement this screenshot'. Also when Paparazzi snapshot testing is mentioned alongside building from a reference. Do NOT trigger for prose-only specs (use compose-component-creator), architecture work, or modifying existing Compose code.
author: jarkendar
